Team —

Quick summary: Helio Systems (prospect moving to pilot) wants an AWS private offer listing. They are asking for two non-standard asks we need exec clearance for: 1) increase marketplace rev-share from our standard 20% to 28% for year 1 (Helio is asking to split an extra 8% to their reseller) and 2) net60 payment terms on a 12-month committed purchase with $420k ARR estimate.

Why this matters: the rev-share lift materially impacts our gross margin on marketplace revenue and the net60 moves receivable timing beyond our typical net30 expectations. The commit is attractive but sensitive to price. AWS private listing is the channel they prefer.

What I'm requesting:
- Exec approval to make a one-time exception: net60 + rev-share 28% year 1, revert to 20% thereafter (or tiered as legal suggests).
- If not full approval, ask for guidance on fallback: net45 or revenue threshold gating.
- Permission to finalize DocuSign with Helio and list on AWS private marketplace if approved.

Team —

Legal/Finance read: I reviewed the draft (term_redline_helio_v2.docx) and ran the economic sensitivity (pricing-impact-analysis.xlsx). Key points:
- If we accept flat 28% rev-share for year 1 the net impact is approximately a 6.8% reduction to marketplace gross margin for the deal size Marissa provided.
- Net60 introduces credit risk; for a $450k ARR commit we can accept net45 with a modest onboarding holdback (5% of first invoice) or require a credit application and ACH/PO cadence.

Compromise proposal (recommended):
- Approve a sliding rev-share: 24% for year 1 if Helio signs a $500k+ ARR commitment; otherwise 20% standard.
- Approve net45 instead of net60; require a 5% holdback on the first invoice and a credit application.
- Add a clause: if customer prepays >60 days in advance we restore standard terms on renewal.

This mitigates risk and keeps the offer commercially attractive. If you want full 28% + net60 we need Ben or revenue ops exec signoff with documented rationale and an explicit credit cap.

I attached the analysis (pricing-impact-analysis.xlsx). If you want, I can produce the updated redline for DocuSign.

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance Ops (Marketplaces)
Redwood Inference
